title: Ultrasound Molecular Imaging and Visualization of Immune Biomarkers: A New Paradigm for Tumor Immunotherapy Response Assessment

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Ultrasound Molecular Imaging and Visualization of Immune Biomarkers: A New Paradigm for Tumor Immunotherapy Response Assessment》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Cancer immunotherapy has revolutionized the treatment landscape, yet its clinical efficacy is limited by modest objective response rates and the emergence of atypical response patterns such as pseudoprogression and hyperprogression.
